question: Which Phase 7 surfaces are reachable and observable in the real app with NO local model installed, and which genuinely require one?

steps.name: precondition
steps.detail: ~/Downloads already holds 1 .gguf file(s), which resolveModelPath searches: Qwen_Qwen3-1.7B-Q4_K_M.gguf — so the "multi-GB download" this record calls a blocker has already happened on this machine

steps.name: seed-queue
steps.detail: two tasks persisted into jp-study-local-agent-task-queue-v1 (one queued, one paused) — the model was never involved

steps.name: navigate
steps.detail: Toolbox -> Local AI Agent after 1 click(s): clicked

steps.name: queue-renders
steps.detail: the Task queue table rendered 2 persisted task(s) with no model: [paused] Resume/Cancel  [queued] Pause/Cancel/Prioritize

steps.name: cancel-resume-prioritize
steps.detail: after real clicks, persisted state is: queued task -> cancelled (priority 100 after Prioritize), paused task -> queued. Before: [{"id":"slice48-queued","status":"queued","priority":0},{"id":"slice48-paused","status":"paused","priority":0}]

steps.name: cancel-is-terminal
steps.detail: the cancelled row now offers [] — cancel is terminal in the UI, not a toggle

steps.name: queue-does-not-feed-the-runner
steps.detail: with two tasks in the persisted queue, the step controls read "Run next approved step" disabled=true, "Confirm sensitive step" disabled=true — they are gated on the in-memory `task`, which only `plan()` ever sets, so a queued task cannot be run, previewed step-by-step, confirmed, or audited.

steps.name: model-gate
steps.detail: agent disabled -> "The local agent is disabled in Settings." (0 ms); enabled but pointed at a model that does not exist -> "No local GGUF model was found. Place a supported Qwen3 model in the app models folder or Downloads." (1 ms). Two DIFFERENT refusals from the same call is what makes the second one the model gate rather than a generic failure — a refusal on its own has no positive observable.

disabled.error: The local agent is disabled in Settings.

noModel.error: No local GGUF model was found. Place a supported Qwen3 model in the app models folder or Downloads.

steps.name: model-present
steps.detail: the app itself finds 1 local model(s): Qwen_Qwen3-1.7B-Q4_K_M.gguf (1.28 GB, downloads)

steps.name: plan-clicked
steps.detail: objective typed, "Create local plan" clicked — the panel's own button, not an IPC call

steps.name: preview
steps.detail: the Task plan table rendered 1 step(s) BEFORE anything ran: study.preview-cards=Queued; summary "Preview five study cards from my deck"
status: Plan ready. Review it before running.

steps.name: audit
steps.detail: the Execution log rendered 2 audit event(s): tool-started · study.preview-cards | tool-failed · study.preview-cards · No active Study vocabulary workspace is available. · 4ms
events: tool-failed · study.preview-cards · No active Study vocabulary workspace is available. · 4ms
steps: No active Study vocabulary workspace is available.

steps.name: confirm-first-attempt
steps.detail: the plan this model produced contained no step whose operation carries a confirmation reason. Every confirming operation in AGENT_TOOL_OPERATIONS needs full-automation, and evaluateAgentToolAccess checks the permission level BEFORE the confirmation reason — so under limited-actions such a step is DENIED, never held for confirmation.

steps.name: profile-and-permission
steps.detail: active profile -> set:Automation Assistant, permission -> set:Full automation; the authorization inputs are themselves a live Phase 7 surface

steps.name: confirm
steps.detail: a step was held for confirmation and the confirmed run produced: confirmation-required · settings.apply-theme | tool-started · settings.apply-theme | tool-completed · settings.apply-theme · 2ms
